text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Miss Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Sorry, what was that...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No, I'm leaving soon, so I just wanted to say hello.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right.
It's time...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I'm fine.
I was just lost in thought.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Let's both... run a race with no regrets.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Then—at Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
This year's Sprinters Stakes also featured a wide array of notable Uma Musume contenders.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Yamanin Zephyr!
Looking forward to seeing how far she can push it today.
(Yamanin Zephyr... A Classic-class Umamusume with a mysterious air. Though without graded stakes wins, she challenges the GⅠ following the call of the wind.)

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well, Zephyr's caught my eye too, but
speaking of the current Classic class... Ah, here she comes!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, keep the camera steady!
—Those two are stepping up!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby!
K.S.Miracle~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Miracle's on a serious roll right now! Couldn't she set another record today?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "Ruby's run in the Yasuda Kinen... It's burned into my memory. D-Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: K.S.Miracle breaking record after record, Daiichi Ruby of the "Splendid Clan"...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Who is truly the fastest...
We'll find out today...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Everyone,
thank you for your cheers.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Today... I'll show you a miracle.
I promise...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Even if I have to sacrifice everything.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
...Isn't Miracle... incredible?
It's almost... a little scary.

Just as I had heard from Daiichi Ruby,
K.S.Miracle had clearly pushed herself
to the absolute limit to prepare.

Though she seemed her usual gentle self,
there was an almost demonic intensity to her aura.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (—I will show them.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(The realm you reached—
I will attain that same speed.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(—And reaching even beyond that...
Do so, and you too shall see the future.)

text_block_list.name: Young Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(I'll achieve glorious feats in races
and become the pride of our family. And then...
right in the center, next to Mother...!)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(—Just like me, who was guided
by everyone's radiance.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ――...I will win.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Today... I'll run faster than anyone... and show everyone—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Looking forward to working with you today.
No need to hold back, of course."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of what neither of us can yield...
let us compete—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Even if I must sacrifice everything.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I simply cannot yield the fastest brilliance to you as you are now.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To overwrite "that" which was given by you
is my...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "As the one standing at the forefront, allow me to guide you to even greater heights."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Please, feast your eyes
upon the thrilling running style of the “Magnificent Clan.”

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—In today's race,
I shall claim victory without fail.

"Right before heading to the race...
Daiichi Ruby suddenly made that declaration."
She had always seen only victory as a member of the "Splendid Clan." What could it mean for her to deliberately make a declaration now...?
choice_data_list: （……For now, I'll stay quiet and listen.）

text_block_list.text:
"She must be speaking right now...
to sort through all the feelings she's pouring into this race."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
An absolute, overwhelming victory.
...So that the light ahead may be seen.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"A brilliance so blinding,
it made me long to surpass it—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To guide toward the future we must reach,
I will display the greatest brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "That is my... no, the duty of the Illustrious Clan."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...For the first time, I truly,
truly understand that from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, toward the future.
We must move forward—on our own two legs."

It seems her mind is made up.
In that case, there's only one thing left to say—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —I shall fulfill my mission.
